source.rule: SystemStructure links two child systems to one operational mother; each child contains one LRU. Only the top system is deployed, while calendar PM is assigned to leaf child A, not the composite mother.

predeclared_native_acceptance: Guarded session-0 SSH import/export exactly preserves every populated authored table, including SystemStructure and both child-to-item relations; converter errors and notes are zero and valid SXO, event log, and report are generated.

Only TEACH-AIR-01 is deployed. Native behavior identifies a leaf-child-A calendar PM, retains the two D03-parent mission completions before hour24 and third mission around hour32, and the mother aircraft's availability is reconciled through PM and terminal state.

Inspect all native warnings and runtime errors, individual PM events, SystemResults time bins, mission results and terminal readiness; do not infer subsystem-specific report rows if the installed CLI omits them.

Seal source and raw hashes, preserve GUI PID13340 and Prelife Log registry setting, and require independent read-only replay before publication. If the converter rejects or behavior differs, preserve as a diagnostic and revise the bounded claim rather than silently accepting.
limits: This first G12 variant fixes two leaf subsystems with one zero-failure LRU each and one leaf calendar PM; failure propagation, QTYPM/ENVF changes, wrong-level PM/repair, and independent child deployment remain separate variants.
GUI visual behavior and cross-engine parity are unverified.
